sentences.text: The documents do not state the EMI for a loan of INR 10,00,000 at an annual interest rate of 9% for 120 months.

The documents define EMI as the equated monthly instalment, and the in-force KFS gives an EMI amount of ₹21,696 for a home loan with a sanctioned loan amount of ₹25,00,000 and a loan term of 240 months, not for this loan.
